fields.name: baseStatisticsMod
fields.label: Change Pokémon stats

options.label: Shuffle each Pokémon’s stats (same total strength)
Randomize each stat (can change total strength)

fields.help: Change how much a Pokémon’s HP, Attack, Defense, and other stats can change.

fields.name: baseStatsFollowEvolutions
fields.label: Keep stat changes consistent across evolutions
fields.help: Use the base Pokémon’s stat changes as a guide for its evolutions.

fields.name: baseStatsFollowMegaEvolutions
fields.label: Keep stat changes consistent with Mega Evolutions
fields.help: Keep Mega Evolution stat changes related to the regular form.

fields.name: assignEvoStatsRandomly
fields.label: Give each evolution its own stat changes
fields.help: Roll separate stats for each evolution instead of carrying the base form’s roll forward.

fields.name: updateBaseStats
fields.label: Use newer-generation stats
fields.help: Update existing Pokémon to newer official stats; this does not add new species.

fields.name: updateBaseStatsToGeneration
fields.label: Update stats to
fields.help: Turn this on to apply this optional rule during randomization.

fields.name: standardizeEXPCurves
fields.label: Use a shared experience-growth rate
fields.help: Give selected Pokémon the same experience growth curve to make leveling more consistent.

fields.name: selectedEXPCurve
fields.label: Experience-growth rate
fields.help: Turn this on to apply this optional rule during randomization.

fields.name: expCurveMod
fields.label: Apply this to
fields.help: Turn this on to apply this optional rule during randomization.

fields.name: typesMod
fields.label: Change Pokémon types

options.label: Randomize types; usually keep them through evolutions
Fully random types; evolutions can change type too

fields.help: Turn this on to apply this optional rule during randomization.

fields.name: typesFollowMegaEvolutions
fields.label: Keep types consistent with Mega Evolutions
fields.help: Keep a Mega Evolution related to the regular form’s randomized type.

fields.name: dualTypeOnly
fields.label: Give every Pokémon two types
fields.help: Make randomized Pokémon dual-type instead of allowing single types.

fields.name: abilitiesMod
fields.label: Change Pokémon abilities
fields.help: Give Pokémon different abilities. The engine keeps Wonder Guard’s special rules in mind.

fields.name: allowWonderGuard
fields.label: Allow Wonder Guard on randomized Pokémon
fields.help: Wonder Guard makes a Pokémon immune to most attacks. Allowing it can make some battles much harder.

fields.name: abilitiesFollowEvolutions
fields.label: Keep abilities consistent across evolutions
fields.help: Give a Pokémon’s regular evolutions related randomized abilities.

fields.name: abilitiesFollowMegaEvolutions
fields.label: Keep abilities consistent with Mega Evolutions
fields.help: Keep Mega Evolution abilities related to the regular form.

fields.name: banTrappingAbilities
fields.label: Exclude abilities that prevent switching
fields.help: Avoid Arena Trap, Magnet Pull, and Shadow Tag in new ability slots.

fields.name: banNegativeAbilities
fields.label: Exclude abilities with only negative effects
fields.help: Avoid abilities whose main effect is harmful to their user.

fields.name: banBadAbilities
fields.label: Exclude weak or harmful abilities
fields.help: Avoid abilities the randomizer classifies as poor choices.

fields.name: weighDuplicateAbilitiesTogether
fields.label: Treat duplicate ability slots as one choice
fields.help: Reduce the chance of an ability appearing twice in the same Pokémon’s slots.

fields.name: ensureTwoAbilities
fields.label: Give each Pokémon two different abilities when possible
fields.help: Try to give Pokémon two distinct ability choices where the game supports it.

fields.name: evolutionsMod
fields.label: Change evolution lines

options.label: Randomize each step in the evolution line

fields.help: Turn this on to apply this optional rule during randomization.

fields.name: evosSimilarStrength
fields.label: Keep replacement evolutions at similar strength
fields.help: When enabled, replacements stay close to the original evolution’s strength. Leave off for fully random evolutions.

fields.name: evosSameTyping
fields.label: Prefer evolutions with the same type
fields.help: Prefer replacement evolutions that keep the original Pokémon’s type.

fields.name: evosMaxThreeStages
fields.label: Keep evolution lines to three stages or fewer
fields.help: Avoid creating evolution lines longer than three Pokémon.

fields.name: evosForceChange
fields.label: Make sure each changed evolution is different
fields.help: Prevent a Pokémon from keeping its original evolution when possible.

fields.name: evosAllowAltFormes
fields.label: Include alternate forms as evolutions
fields.help: Allow alternate forms in evolution choices where the game supports them.

fields.name: changeImpossibleEvolutions
fields.label: Replace evolutions that are impossible in this game
fields.help: Replace trade or other hard-to-trigger evolutions with alternatives available in this game.

fields.name: makeEvolutionsEasier
fields.label: Make difficult evolutions easier to trigger
fields.help: Lower difficult evolution requirements where the game supports the change.

fields.name: removeTimeBasedEvolutions
fields.label: Remove evolutions that require a time of day
fields.help: Remove requirements that an evolution happen at a particular time of day.

fields.name: startersMod
fields.label: Change the starter choices

options.label: Any Pokémon can be a starter
Choose starters that can evolve twice

fields.help: Turn this on to apply this optional rule during randomization.

fields.name: customStarters
fields.label: Choose your own starters
fields.help: Turn this on to apply this optional rule during randomization.

fields.name: randomizeStartersHeldItems
fields.label: Randomize starter held items
fields.help: Give randomized held items to the starter choices.

fields.name: banBadRandomStarterHeldItems
fields.label: Exclude poor starter held items
fields.help: Keep poor or unusable items off randomized starters.

fields.name: allowStarterAltFormes
fields.label: Allow Alternate Formes
fields.help: Allow alternate forms to be selected as starters.

fields.name: staticPokemonMod
fields.label: Change gift and fixed Pokémon

options.label: Any Pokémon can replace a gift or fixed encounter

fields.help: Turn this on to apply this optional rule during randomization.

fields.name: allowStaticAltFormes
fields.label: Allow Alternate Formes
fields.help: Allow alternate forms for gifts and fixed encounters.

fields.name: swapStaticMegaEvos
fields.label: Swap Mega Evolvables
fields.help: When possible, swap Mega-capable Pokémon with other Mega-capable Pokémon.

fields.name: limitMainGameLegendaries
fields.label: Limit Main Game Legendaries
fields.help: Avoid using too many legendary Pokémon in the main story’s fixed encounters.

fields.name: limit600
fields.label: Limit 600 BST
fields.help: Keep Pokémon with a 600-point base-stat total out of this random pool.

fields.name: staticLevelModified
fields.label: Adjust gift and fixed Pokémon levels
fields.help: Change the levels of gift Pokémon and other fixed encounters.

fields.name: staticLevelModifier
fields.label: Gift/fixed Pokémon level adjustment
fields.help: Turn this on to apply this optional rule during randomization.

fields.name: correctStaticMusic
fields.label: Correct Static Music
fields.help: Update encounter music to match the randomized fixed Pokémon when supported.

fields.name: inGameTradesMod
fields.label: Change in-game trades
fields.help: Turn this on to apply this optional rule during randomization.

fields.name: randomizeInGameTradesNicknames
fields.label: Randomize Nicknames
fields.help: Give traded Pokémon new nicknames.

fields.name: randomizeInGameTradesOTs
fields.label: Randomize OTs
fields.help: Give traded Pokémon new original-trainer names.

fields.name: randomizeInGameTradesIVs
fields.label: Randomize IVs
fields.help: Randomize the traded Pokémon’s individual values.

fields.name: randomizeInGameTradesItems
fields.label: Randomize Held Items
fields.help: Randomize items held by Pokémon received in trades.

fields.name: randomizeMovePowers
fields.label: Randomize move power
fields.help: Change how much damage moves can deal.

fields.name: randomizeMoveAccuracies
fields.label: Randomize move accuracy
fields.help: Change the chance that moves hit their target.

fields.name: randomizeMovePPs
fields.label: Randomize move PP
fields.help: Change how many times moves can be used before they need to be restored.

fields.name: randomizeMoveTypes
fields.label: Randomize move types
fields.help: Change the elemental type assigned to moves.

fields.name: randomizeMoveCategory
fields.label: Randomize physical/special categories
fields.help: Change whether moves use physical or special damage rules.

fields.name: updateMoves
fields.label: Use updated move data
fields.help: Apply newer move data where supported by this game.

fields.name: updateMovesToGeneration
fields.label: Update moves to
fields.help: Turn this on to apply this optional rule during randomization.

fields.name: updateMovesLegacy
fields.label: Legacy Updates
fields.help: Use compatibility-focused values when updating older move data.

fields.name: movesetsMod
fields.label: Change level-up moves

options.label: Random moves, usually matching the Pokémon’s type
Completely random moves from the full move pool

fields.help: Choose the moves Pokémon learn as they level up. Completely random uses the full move pool without type matching.

fields.name: startWithGuaranteedMoves
fields.label: Give Pokémon a useful starting moveset
fields.help: Give randomized learnsets a small useful starting moveset.

fields.name: guaranteedMoveCount
fields.label: Starting moves per Pokémon
fields.help: Turn this on to apply this optional rule during randomization.

fields.name: reorderDamagingMoves
fields.label: Place damaging moves later in the learnset
fields.help: Place damaging moves later so early levels are less punishing.

fields.name: movesetsForceGoodDamaging
fields.label: Ensure some damaging moves are included
fields.help: Ensure randomized learnsets include damaging moves at the chosen percentage.

fields.name: movesetsGoodDamagingPercent
fields.label: Minimum share of damaging moves
fields.help: Turn this on to apply this optional rule during randomization.

fields.name: blockBrokenMovesetMoves
fields.label: Exclude moves that can break the game
fields.help: Keep moves considered game-breaking out of level-up learnsets.

fields.name: evolutionMovesForAll
fields.label: Let all Pokémon learn evolution moves
fields.help: Allow Pokémon to learn moves normally reserved for evolving.

fields.name: trainersMod
fields.label: Change trainer teams

options.label: Random teams spread Pokémon across trainers
Give each trainer a type theme
Type themes for Gyms and the Elite Four

fields.help: Turn this on to apply this optional rule during randomization.

fields.name: rivalCarriesStarterThroughout
fields.label: Keep the rival’s starter on their team
fields.help: Keep the rival’s starter on their team throughout the story.

fields.name: trainersUsePokemonOfSimilarStrength
fields.label: Match the original Pokémon’s strength
fields.help: When enabled, trainer Pokémon stay close to the original strength. Leave off for fully random teams.

fields.name: trainersMatchTypingDistribution
fields.label: Keep a similar mix of types on each team
fields.help: Keep roughly the same type mix as each trainer’s original team.

fields.name: trainersBlockLegendaries
fields.label: Exclude legendary Pokémon from trainer teams
fields.help: Keep legendary Pokémon out of randomized trainer teams.

fields.name: trainersBlockEarlyWonderGuard
fields.label: Prevent early trainers from getting Wonder Guard
fields.help: Avoid giving early trainers Pokémon with Wonder Guard.

fields.name: trainersEnforceDistribution
fields.label: Enforce Distribution
fields.help: Reduce repeated Pokémon across the randomized trainer teams.

fields.name: trainersEnforceMainPlaythrough
fields.label: Enforce Main Playthrough
fields.help: Spread choices across the main story so trainer teams vary more.

fields.name: randomizeTrainerNames
fields.label: Randomize trainer names
fields.help: Replace trainer names with randomized names.

fields.name: randomizeTrainerClassNames
fields.label: Randomize trainer classes
fields.help: Replace trainer classes, such as Hiker or Lass, with randomized classes.

fields.name: trainersForceFullyEvolved
fields.label: Give high-level trainers fully evolved Pokémon
fields.help: Once a trainer’s Pokémon reaches the level below, use a final evolution when one is available.

fields.name: trainersForceFullyEvolvedLevel
fields.label: Fully evolved Pokémon start at level
fields.help: This is the level at which the game starts using final evolutions for trainers.

fields.name: trainersLevelModified

fields.name: trainersLevelModifier
fields.label: Trainer level adjustment

fields.name: randomizeHeldItemsForImportantTrainerPokemon

fields.name: randomizeHeldItemsForRegularTrainerPokemon
